source.note: Base list is the 2026-09-09 wiki extract. Burrowbuck Saddle and Cerberax Saddle were added from that page on 2026-10-23. Boaratos Saddle and Galleon have empty class cells on the wiki; their specifiers, levels, and point costs come from Beacon. Crystal Isles, Lost Island, Fjordur, and Genesis Part 2 classes are omitted because those maps are not in ASA. level and points are the game defaults. They are not written until the operator sets them.
